svg.text: A round head, a bean body, four rounded tubes. No hands, feet, hair or neck. The tired face does the acting.
a still in this style: the Pull at his back, tied to the phone
FACE (heavy lids at rest: an adult, not a kid)
The whole rig: head (2 eyes, 2 lids, 2 brows, mouth), body, 4 tubes. A pose is 8 joint angles.
Ours, not the genre's stock: his face and long limbs; the amber shadow, tied by a thread, that takes his eyes at stage 4.
